title: Thumbnail Designer (Art Director)  - Crypto Media
description:
We are the world’s No.1 LIVE Crypto Streaming Channel, covering Bitcoin, breaking news, altcoins, market moves, and the biggest names in the industry — every single day. From two enthusiasts streaming from a coffee shop to one of the fastest-growing crypto media networks, we now run a consortium of top YouTube channels for live news, trading, investing, web3, and gaming, partnering with the biggest brands and advertisers in the space. Born from a career at CNBC and the world’s first televised daily crypto news show, Crypto Banter was created to break free from corporate media and lead the Media 2.0 movement for tech, finance, and crypto .Today, with 80+ team members and over 10M monthly views, we’re hungrier than ever to build the most profitable and engaged community in the world. We’re a team of enthusiasts, misfits, and entrepreneurs who work harder than anyone in the industry — driven by passion, obsession, and the pursuit of the impossible. If that sounds like you, join us!


Role Overview

Crypto Banter creates multiple design assets on a daily basis for our content platforms. These design thumbnails encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching, interesting manner and act as a marketing asset for each show. We are looking for an art director with crypto knowledge that can assist the design team in conceptualizing and executing these designs and thumbnails on a daily basis. This role requires experience and knowledge of crypto to understand stories or news events and translate that understanding into punchy, eye-catching and impactful thumbnails to be used and packaged with the content that is distributed.


What you’ll do

  • Lead and Scale the Creative Squad: Direct a high-performance design team of three, managing the end-to-end execution of daily visual assets while collaborating with the Lead Art Director to maintain \"Brilliance or Nothing\" standards.
  • Conceptualise Viral Storytelling: Translate complex crypto news, market shifts, and \"breaking\" narratives into punchy, high-CTR YouTube thumbnails that encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching and urgent manner possible.
  • Rapid News Translation & Relay: Spearhead daily morning briefing calls to digest the latest market moves and breaking stories, immediately distilling these insights into actionable creative briefs for the design team.
  • Optimise for Performance & CTR: Apply a deep understanding of YouTube’s backend mechanics and audience psychology to create assets that win the \"click\" by a mile, ensuring all packaging is impactful and market-relevant.
  • Operationalise Design Workflows: Build and maintain a seamless, efficient design process that can withstand the intense time constraints of a live streaming environment, ensuring every show asset is ready for the \"Stream Team\" before go-live.
  • Cross-Functional Creative Direction: Provide expert art direction and execution for diverse auxiliary projects across the media network, ensuring a consistent and \"elite\" visual identity across all platforms.



Your skills and experience

  • Visual Storytelling and Execution: Proven ability to turn complex crypto narratives and \"breaking\" market news into high-impact YouTube thumbnails that are simple, urgent, and designed to win the click.
  • Crypto Fluency and Market Literacy: A deep-rooted \"fellow degen\" mentality with a daily obsession for watching the charts, following altcoins, and tracking the world’s biggest market moves.
  • Creative Leadership and Briefing: Experienced in leading and managing international design teams, with the ability to relay complex daily stories into clear, actionable creative briefs for rapid execution.
  • YouTube Psychology and Backend Mastery: A strong understanding of YouTube mechanics, specifically focusing on click-through rates (CTR) and audience retention strategies used by top-tier crypto and finance channels.
  • High-Velocity Performance: Exceptional ability to work under intense pressure and tight time constraints, delivering production-ready assets for live shows on a daily basis.
  • Strategic Communication and Copywriting: Sharp copywriting skills used to craft titles and visual hooks that capture attention while maintaining transparency and brand integrity

description:

title: Senior Front-End Software Engineer (React.js / React Native / TypeScript)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Front-End Software Engineer with 5+ years of professional front-end development experience using React.js, React Native, and TypeScript for our U.K. / U.S. client. You will design, build, and maintain high‑impact user interfaces — from customer dashboards and data visualizations to our React Native mobile app.

Our client is a nature data and intelligence company on a mission to drive large-scale nature recovery. They combine data, science, and technology to help enterprises value and restore nature, creating measurable environmental and economic impact.


Responsibilities

  • Own front-end delivery for key product surfaces across web and mobile taking features from technical feasibility through technical design, implementation, release, and iteration
  • Build and evolve UI foundations including component patterns, design-system primitives, reusable layouts, and interaction standards that keep UX consistent as the product scales
  • Translate product and design intent into clear, intuitive user flows sweating the details on information hierarchy, micro-interactions, accessibility, and polish
  • Ship performant, data-heavy interfaces in Next.js / React.js, with strong attention to perceived performance (e.g., loading states, empty states, progressive disclosure, and responsiveness)
  • Contribute meaningfully to the React Native app, delivering cross-platform UI and shared patterns where it makes sense, while handling platform-specific edge cases when needed
  • Use automated testing to ensure the UI quality, stability, and performance
  • Partner tightly with Product, Design, and Tech Lead to scope work into thin, shippable increments, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and keep delivery moving without sacrificing quality


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of professional experience building production, front-end applications with React.js and TypeScript
  • Experience building and supporting cross-platform, React Native features in a production application
  • Strong eye for UI and UX quality, paying close attention to interaction behavior, information hierarchy, accessibility, and polish
  • Proven experience implementing and operating within a component library / design system (e.g., tokens, reusable components, consistency, and documentation) in close collaboration with Design
  • Strong fundamentals in state management, responsive design, and performance optimization including perceived performance (e.g., loading states, skeletons, optimistic UI, and smooth interactions)
  • Comfortable taking ambiguous product requirements and turning them into clear UI flows, iterating quickly with stakeholders, and owning outcomes
  • Shareable portfolio or examples of UI work (e.g. links, screenshots) as well as the ability to explain what you personally owned and enhanced
  • Proactive mindset and the ability to self-manage in a distributed environment
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment


Desired Experience

  • Experience with mobile release workflows (App Store / Play Store), build tooling, and troubleshooting React Native native-module / platform-specific issues
  • Experience with data visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js, Recharts) and/or map-based UI (e.g., Mapbox)


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Data Analyst | Ecommerce (Full-time Remote, BR)
description:
About Us:

Carepod is a premium humidifier brand operating in the US, Canada, and Australia. We’re growing fast and building a data-driven culture where insights actually shape decisions.

We’re looking for a Data Analyst who thinks like a business partner, not just a report builder.


What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain dashboards & projection tools such as sales, marketing, inventory, etc.
  • Analyze ecommerce & marketing data (Shopify, ads, reviews)
  • Identify trends in conversion, retention, and customer behavior
  • Support leadership with clear insights and recommendations
  • Answer real business questions, fast


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years experience as a Data Analyst
  • Strong SQL + Excel / Google Sheets
  • Experience with dashboards & KPIs
  • Exeprience with AI Automations such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, n8n, Make, Airtable, etc.
  • Ecommerce or DTC experience preferred
  • Comfortable communicating insights in English
  • Bonus: Python, BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI)


Why Carepod

  • Direct exposure to leadership
  • Real impact on decisions
  • International business experience
  • Fully remote, long-term opportunity


What We Offer:

 • Fully remote work environment

 • Competitive salary

 • Flexible PTO policy

 • Opportunity to grow with a scaling e-commerce brand

 • A supportive, collaborative, and agile team culture


⸻


To Apply:

  • Send your resume and a short note about why you’re a great fit

title: Supervisor de Inventário | DF
description:
Somos gente que cuida de gente. Cada um com características, histórias e qualidades únicas, mas todos unidos pelo mesmo propósito: viver plenamente. Temos orgulho da nossa história, por isso fazemos o nosso melhor hoje, sem deixar de olhar para o amanhã.


Se você preza pela valorização humana, integridade, foco no cliente, superação de resultados, sustentabilidade, inovação em soluções em tudo o que faz, vem fazer parte do nosso time de gigantes.


Como é o ambiente de trabalho?


Oferecemos um ambiente em que todos são protagonistas e agentes de transformação. Temos um excelente clima organizacional com pessoas engajadas em entregar os melhores resultados, assim como grandes oportunidades de crescimento para você.


Vem conferir!


Responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar equipes e procedimentos operacionais;
  • Zelar pelos equipamentos da companhia;
  • Realizar e acompanhar inventários de estoque de produtos em lojas e centros de distribuição;
  • Realizar inventário de materiais e ativos de TI.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior Cursando ou Completo na área Logística, Administrativa ou áreas afins;
  • Vivência básica na área de gestão;
  • Flexibilidade de horário;
  • Conhecimento em Prevenção de Perdas e/ou processos de Inventário;
  • Conhecimento no Pacote Office (Excel, Word e Access).

title: Thumbnail Designer (Art Director)  - Crypto Media
description:
We are the world’s No.1 LIVE Crypto Streaming Channel, covering Bitcoin, breaking news, altcoins, market moves, and the biggest names in the industry — every single day. From two enthusiasts streaming from a coffee shop to one of the fastest-growing crypto media networks, we now run a consortium of top YouTube channels for live news, trading, investing, web3, and gaming, partnering with the biggest brands and advertisers in the space. Born from a career at CNBC and the world’s first televised daily crypto news show, Crypto Banter was created to break free from corporate media and lead the Media 2.0 movement for tech, finance, and crypto .Today, with 80+ team members and over 10M monthly views, we’re hungrier than ever to build the most profitable and engaged community in the world. We’re a team of enthusiasts, misfits, and entrepreneurs who work harder than anyone in the industry — driven by passion, obsession, and the pursuit of the impossible. If that sounds like you, join us!


Role Overview

Crypto Banter creates multiple design assets on a daily basis for our content platforms. These design thumbnails encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching, interesting manner and act as a marketing asset for each show. We are looking for an art director with crypto knowledge that can assist the design team in conceptualizing and executing these designs and thumbnails on a daily basis. This role requires experience and knowledge of crypto to understand stories or news events and translate that understanding into punchy, eye-catching and impactful thumbnails to be used and packaged with the content that is distributed.


What you’ll do

  • Lead and Scale the Creative Squad: Direct a high-performance design team of three, managing the end-to-end execution of daily visual assets while collaborating with the Lead Art Director to maintain \"Brilliance or Nothing\" standards.
  • Conceptualise Viral Storytelling: Translate complex crypto news, market shifts, and \"breaking\" narratives into punchy, high-CTR YouTube thumbnails that encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching and urgent manner possible.
  • Rapid News Translation & Relay: Spearhead daily morning briefing calls to digest the latest market moves and breaking stories, immediately distilling these insights into actionable creative briefs for the design team.
  • Optimise for Performance & CTR: Apply a deep understanding of YouTube’s backend mechanics and audience psychology to create assets that win the \"click\" by a mile, ensuring all packaging is impactful and market-relevant.
  • Operationalise Design Workflows: Build and maintain a seamless, efficient design process that can withstand the intense time constraints of a live streaming environment, ensuring every show asset is ready for the \"Stream Team\" before go-live.
  • Cross-Functional Creative Direction: Provide expert art direction and execution for diverse auxiliary projects across the media network, ensuring a consistent and \"elite\" visual identity across all platforms.



Your skills and experience

  • Visual Storytelling and Execution: Proven ability to turn complex crypto narratives and \"breaking\" market news into high-impact YouTube thumbnails that are simple, urgent, and designed to win the click.
  • Crypto Fluency and Market Literacy: A deep-rooted \"fellow degen\" mentality with a daily obsession for watching the charts, following altcoins, and tracking the world’s biggest market moves.
  • Creative Leadership and Briefing: Experienced in leading and managing international design teams, with the ability to relay complex daily stories into clear, actionable creative briefs for rapid execution.
  • YouTube Psychology and Backend Mastery: A strong understanding of YouTube mechanics, specifically focusing on click-through rates (CTR) and audience retention strategies used by top-tier crypto and finance channels.
  • High-Velocity Performance: Exceptional ability to work under intense pressure and tight time constraints, delivering production-ready assets for live shows on a daily basis.
  • Strategic Communication and Copywriting: Sharp copywriting skills used to craft titles and visual hooks that capture attention while maintaining transparency and brand integrity

title: Financial Institutions Partnership Director
description:
Job Description

●Build up strategic partnership with major financial institutions in the respective regions/business line, nurturing business collaboration with global banks and other financial institutions to enhance the company services on providing payment, collection and other services that is related to B2B verticals and merchants growth.

●Develop and execute channel partnership strategy through identifying the potential partners, negotiating, closing partnership deals, implementing, and managing complex partnership engagements.

●Ensure project deliverable in terms of channel integration and optimisation are executed with quality and timely.

●Review process gaps, identify areas for improvement and drive the payment optimisation. ●Manage partnerships to review success factors and hold periodic meetings to discuss sales & marketing strategies, lead-gen, and new products/features.

●Research on the business model and compliance policy of oversea funds management practice in local market.



The Successful Applicant:

●Min 5 years of working experience in collaboration with local financial institution or payment channel industry.

●In-depth understanding on local regulation and compliance regarding payment business and cross border fund movement.

●Experience in negotiation and partnership proposal development

●Ability to maintain high efficiency across different countries

●Solid interpersonal skills, logical thinking and analytical skills

●Highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities, enjoys working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

title: Analista de Dados & Analytics Pleno
description:
Vem ser Ituber & vem fazer Itaú

O Itaú é a marca mais valiosa do Brasil, a melhor empresa para trabalhar segundo o Great Place to Work e o maior banco da América Latina. Nós impactamos diariamente mais de 98 milhões de clientes em 18 países.


Somos feitos de pessoas e acreditamos que ter um time com pluralidade de origens, culturas, crenças, experiências, raças, deficiências, gêneros, orientações afetivo-sexuais e gerações ampliam as perspectivas e contribuem para um clima de respeito e valorização das diferenças.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados Pleno com forte conhecimento técnico e perfil analítico para atuar na construção de soluções de dados, automação de processos e desenvolvimento de dashboards estratégicos. Essa posição é ideal para quem gosta de trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados, criar insights e apoiar decisões de negcio com tecnologia e análise.


Por que você vai amar trabalhar conosco:

  • Projetos desafiadores e inovadores.
  • Ambiente colaborativo e foco em desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Oportunidade de impactar decisões estratégicas com soluções baseadas em dados.


Estamos buscando uma pessoa para a posição de Analista de Dados & Analytics Pleno , que queira se desenvolver e aprender, compartilhar, colaborar e inovar, entregando valor para todos os nossos clientes.


Se você é apaixonado por dados e tecnologia, essa oportunidade é para você!

Estamos buscando um(a) Analista de Dados Pleno com experiência em Python, AWS e criação de dashboards para integrar nosso time.


Nessa função você vai:

  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando Python e serviços AWS.
  • Criar dashboards interativos e relatórios gerenciais (Power BI, QuickSight ou similares).
  • Automatizar rotinas e processos para otimização de tempo e qualidade.
  • Garantir a integridade, qualidade e segurança dos dados.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e propor soluções
  • Apoiar na definição de métricas e indicadores de performance.


No que você precisa mandar bem?

  • Conhecimento sólido em Python
  • Habilidades em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais
  • Noções de conhecimento dos serviços AWS (Glue, S3, Lambda, QuickSight ou serviços relacionados)
  • Experiência na criação de dashboards e indicadores (Power BI, Tableau ou AWS QuickSight).


Você sairá na frente se mandar bem:

  • Certificações em AWS ou ferramentas de BI.
  • Experiência com Data Mesh ou arquiteturas distribuídas.


Ao se tornar um ituber você tem_

  • Vale-Transporte
  • Vale-Refeição (Restaurantes) / Vale-Alimentação (Supermercados)
  • Plano médico (Fundação Saúde Itaú ou Central Nacional Unimed)
  • Plano odontológico (Odontoprev ou Interodonto)
  • Seguro de Vida
  • PLR – Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (Mediante resultados do banco)
  • Previdência privada
  • Descontos exclusivos em nossos produtos financeiros
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida
  • Auxílio Creche / Babá (para papais e mamães)
  • Incentivo a estudos
  • Wellhub ou TotalPass
  • Acesso aos Clubes de Lazer Itaú (Guarapiranga / Itanhaém e São Sebastião)
  • + Algumas vantagens que você pode conhecer durante o processo

title: Electrical Engineer
description:
Position Challenges

Plan, organize and monitor the activities of electrical part (Equipment for manufacturing products such as Automation, Conveyor, Utilities, etc). Supervise and guide the maintenance team directly. Ensure the operation of electric equipment to meet the production process. Guarantee compliance with all procedures established both internally and externally.


Roles & Responsibilities

• Monitor the execution of general maintenance activities in the field with a record through a report and photos to evidence the process.

• Plan and monitor preventive, corrective and predictive maintenance to maintain the operation of equipment and facilities with daily control or according to an elaborate plan.

• Analyze technical or third-party activities for high quality standard service, through daily monitoring with follow-up report.

• Participate in inventories to control products and assets, following the company's procedure whenever requested.

• Comply with the company's internal rules and procedures and current legislation.

• Conduct training for outsourced employees periodically.

• When responsible for low and high voltage electrical activities, check and/or perform installations, maintenance and/or operations.

• Make programming, pass on to those involved and monitor the activities and reports for their execution.

• Purchase and control of parts and parts for warehouse and execution of department activities, through the internal flow of purchases when necessary.

• Prepare descriptive memorials through a budget spreadsheet for quoting external services when necessary.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in electrical and related engineering
  • CREA register active
  • Desirable Post-Graduation in the area.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office Package
  • Advanced English
  • AutoCad
  • TPM - Total Productive Maintenance
  • FMEA


Certifications

  • NR-35 - Working at Height
  • NR-10 - Safety in Electricity Installations and Services
  • SEP - Electrical Power System

title: Data Analyst | Ecommerce (Full-time Remote, BR)
description:
About Us:

Carepod is a premium humidifier brand operating in the US, Canada, and Australia. We’re growing fast and building a data-driven culture where insights actually shape decisions.

We’re looking for a Data Analyst who thinks like a business partner, not just a report builder.


What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain dashboards & projection tools such as sales, marketing, inventory, etc.
  • Analyze ecommerce & marketing data (Shopify, ads, reviews)
  • Identify trends in conversion, retention, and customer behavior
  • Support leadership with clear insights and recommendations
  • Answer real business questions, fast


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years experience as a Data Analyst
  • Strong SQL + Excel / Google Sheets
  • Experience with dashboards & KPIs
  • Exeprience with AI Automations such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, n8n, Make, Airtable, etc.
  • Ecommerce or DTC experience preferred
  • Comfortable communicating insights in English
  • Bonus: Python, BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI)


Why Carepod

  • Direct exposure to leadership
  • Real impact on decisions
  • International business experience
  • Fully remote, long-term opportunity


What We Offer:

 • Fully remote work environment

 • Competitive salary

 • Flexible PTO policy

 • Opportunity to grow with a scaling e-commerce brand

 • A supportive, collaborative, and agile team culture


⸻


To Apply:

  • Send your resume and a short note about why you’re a great fit

title: Thumbnail Designer (Art Director)  - Crypto Media
description:
We are the world’s No.1 LIVE Crypto Streaming Channel, covering Bitcoin, breaking news, altcoins, market moves, and the biggest names in the industry — every single day. From two enthusiasts streaming from a coffee shop to one of the fastest-growing crypto media networks, we now run a consortium of top YouTube channels for live news, trading, investing, web3, and gaming, partnering with the biggest brands and advertisers in the space. Born from a career at CNBC and the world’s first televised daily crypto news show, Crypto Banter was created to break free from corporate media and lead the Media 2.0 movement for tech, finance, and crypto .Today, with 80+ team members and over 10M monthly views, we’re hungrier than ever to build the most profitable and engaged community in the world. We’re a team of enthusiasts, misfits, and entrepreneurs who work harder than anyone in the industry — driven by passion, obsession, and the pursuit of the impossible. If that sounds like you, join us!


Role Overview

Crypto Banter creates multiple design assets on a daily basis for our content platforms. These design thumbnails encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching, interesting manner and act as a marketing asset for each show. We are looking for an art director with crypto knowledge that can assist the design team in conceptualizing and executing these designs and thumbnails on a daily basis. This role requires experience and knowledge of crypto to understand stories or news events and translate that understanding into punchy, eye-catching and impactful thumbnails to be used and packaged with the content that is distributed.


What you’ll do

  • Lead and Scale the Creative Squad: Direct a high-performance design team of three, managing the end-to-end execution of daily visual assets while collaborating with the Lead Art Director to maintain \"Brilliance or Nothing\" standards.
  • Conceptualise Viral Storytelling: Translate complex crypto news, market shifts, and \"breaking\" narratives into punchy, high-CTR YouTube thumbnails that encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching and urgent manner possible.
  • Rapid News Translation & Relay: Spearhead daily morning briefing calls to digest the latest market moves and breaking stories, immediately distilling these insights into actionable creative briefs for the design team.
  • Optimise for Performance & CTR: Apply a deep understanding of YouTube’s backend mechanics and audience psychology to create assets that win the \"click\" by a mile, ensuring all packaging is impactful and market-relevant.
  • Operationalise Design Workflows: Build and maintain a seamless, efficient design process that can withstand the intense time constraints of a live streaming environment, ensuring every show asset is ready for the \"Stream Team\" before go-live.
  • Cross-Functional Creative Direction: Provide expert art direction and execution for diverse auxiliary projects across the media network, ensuring a consistent and \"elite\" visual identity across all platforms.



Your skills and experience

  • Visual Storytelling and Execution: Proven ability to turn complex crypto narratives and \"breaking\" market news into high-impact YouTube thumbnails that are simple, urgent, and designed to win the click.
  • Crypto Fluency and Market Literacy: A deep-rooted \"fellow degen\" mentality with a daily obsession for watching the charts, following altcoins, and tracking the world’s biggest market moves.
  • Creative Leadership and Briefing: Experienced in leading and managing international design teams, with the ability to relay complex daily stories into clear, actionable creative briefs for rapid execution.
  • YouTube Psychology and Backend Mastery: A strong understanding of YouTube mechanics, specifically focusing on click-through rates (CTR) and audience retention strategies used by top-tier crypto and finance channels.
  • High-Velocity Performance: Exceptional ability to work under intense pressure and tight time constraints, delivering production-ready assets for live shows on a daily basis.
  • Strategic Communication and Copywriting: Sharp copywriting skills used to craft titles and visual hooks that capture attention while maintaining transparency and brand integrity

title: Senior Front-End Software Engineer (React.js / React Native / TypeScript)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Front-End Software Engineer with 5+ years of professional front-end development experience using React.js, React Native, and TypeScript for our U.K. / U.S. client. You will design, build, and maintain high‑impact user interfaces — from customer dashboards and data visualizations to our React Native mobile app.

Our client is a nature data and intelligence company on a mission to drive large-scale nature recovery. They combine data, science, and technology to help enterprises value and restore nature, creating measurable environmental and economic impact.


Responsibilities

  • Own front-end delivery for key product surfaces across web and mobile taking features from technical feasibility through technical design, implementation, release, and iteration
  • Build and evolve UI foundations including component patterns, design-system primitives, reusable layouts, and interaction standards that keep UX consistent as the product scales
  • Translate product and design intent into clear, intuitive user flows sweating the details on information hierarchy, micro-interactions, accessibility, and polish
  • Ship performant, data-heavy interfaces in Next.js / React.js, with strong attention to perceived performance (e.g., loading states, empty states, progressive disclosure, and responsiveness)
  • Contribute meaningfully to the React Native app, delivering cross-platform UI and shared patterns where it makes sense, while handling platform-specific edge cases when needed
  • Use automated testing to ensure the UI quality, stability, and performance
  • Partner tightly with Product, Design, and Tech Lead to scope work into thin, shippable increments, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and keep delivery moving without sacrificing quality


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of professional experience building production, front-end applications with React.js and TypeScript
  • Experience building and supporting cross-platform, React Native features in a production application
  • Strong eye for UI and UX quality, paying close attention to interaction behavior, information hierarchy, accessibility, and polish
  • Proven experience implementing and operating within a component library / design system (e.g., tokens, reusable components, consistency, and documentation) in close collaboration with Design
  • Strong fundamentals in state management, responsive design, and performance optimization including perceived performance (e.g., loading states, skeletons, optimistic UI, and smooth interactions)
  • Comfortable taking ambiguous product requirements and turning them into clear UI flows, iterating quickly with stakeholders, and owning outcomes
  • Shareable portfolio or examples of UI work (e.g. links, screenshots) as well as the ability to explain what you personally owned and enhanced
  • Proactive mindset and the ability to self-manage in a distributed environment
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment


Desired Experience

  • Experience with mobile release workflows (App Store / Play Store), build tooling, and troubleshooting React Native native-module / platform-specific issues
  • Experience with data visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js, Recharts) and/or map-based UI (e.g., Mapbox)


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Engenheiro de Dados Senior
description:
Na Jaya Tech , acreditamos na Engenharia de Software Consciente , uma abordagem inovadora, e por isso oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho inspirador, focado em promover o autoconhecimento, tomar decisões embasadas em dados, cultivar relacionamentos saudáveis e entender o impacto do nosso trabalho. Aqui, você encontrará oportunidades para crescimento profissional e pessoal, contribuindo para projetos que têm um impacto significativo na indústria e na sociedade.


Sobre o Projeto

Você fará parte de um time em uma empresa inovadora, especializada em desenvolver soluções com Inteligencia Artificial (B2C) contribuindo para a transformação digital desse setor.


Atuação 100% remota | Forma de contratação: Contractor | Reuneração: Dólar | Full-time | Range: 5.2K a 6.2K


Requisitos Necessários


O que estamos procurando:


Ao avaliar candidatos para todos os cargos, buscamos pessoas com forte senso de propriedade, excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração, e dedicação à melhoria contínua.


● Experiência em engenharia de dados

● Domínio de Python e DBT Cloud, incluindo macros, testes, exposures e documentação para ETL/ELT

● Experiência com event streams e stream processing

● Experiência com controle de versão e CI/CD usando GitLab

● Experiência com orquestração de jobs (Airflow, DBT Jobs, Dagster)

● Familiaridade com Snowflake (clustering, otimização de queries, gestão de custos)

● Familiaridade com boas práticas de modelagem de dados (Kimball, Star, Snowflake) e sua aplicação em data warehouses

● Conforto com a linha de comando Unix/Linux



Experiências que vão nos impressionar muito:


● Familiaridade com eCommerce e os desafios de dados anônimos de clientes e suas interações

● Familiaridade com seguros de P&C (Property & Casualty)

● Formação em áreas como: Ciência, Tecnologia, Engenharia e Matemática

title: Thumbnail Designer (Art Director)  - Crypto Media
description:
We are the world’s No.1 LIVE Crypto Streaming Channel, covering Bitcoin, breaking news, altcoins, market moves, and the biggest names in the industry — every single day. From two enthusiasts streaming from a coffee shop to one of the fastest-growing crypto media networks, we now run a consortium of top YouTube channels for live news, trading, investing, web3, and gaming, partnering with the biggest brands and advertisers in the space. Born from a career at CNBC and the world’s first televised daily crypto news show, Crypto Banter was created to break free from corporate media and lead the Media 2.0 movement for tech, finance, and crypto .Today, with 80+ team members and over 10M monthly views, we’re hungrier than ever to build the most profitable and engaged community in the world. We’re a team of enthusiasts, misfits, and entrepreneurs who work harder than anyone in the industry — driven by passion, obsession, and the pursuit of the impossible. If that sounds like you, join us!


Role Overview

Crypto Banter creates multiple design assets on a daily basis for our content platforms. These design thumbnails encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching, interesting manner and act as a marketing asset for each show. We are looking for an art director with crypto knowledge that can assist the design team in conceptualizing and executing these designs and thumbnails on a daily basis. This role requires experience and knowledge of crypto to understand stories or news events and translate that understanding into punchy, eye-catching and impactful thumbnails to be used and packaged with the content that is distributed.


What you’ll do

  • Lead and Scale the Creative Squad: Direct a high-performance design team of three, managing the end-to-end execution of daily visual assets while collaborating with the Lead Art Director to maintain \"Brilliance or Nothing\" standards.
  • Conceptualise Viral Storytelling: Translate complex crypto news, market shifts, and \"breaking\" narratives into punchy, high-CTR YouTube thumbnails that encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching and urgent manner possible.
  • Rapid News Translation & Relay: Spearhead daily morning briefing calls to digest the latest market moves and breaking stories, immediately distilling these insights into actionable creative briefs for the design team.

title: Senior Front-End Software Engineer (React.js / React Native / TypeScript)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Front-End Software Engineer with 5+ years of professional front-end development experience using React.js, React Native, and TypeScript for our U.K. / U.S. client. You will design, build, and maintain high‑impact user interfaces — from customer dashboards and data visualizations to our React Native mobile app.

title: Data Analyst | Ecommerce (Full-time Remote, BR)
description:
About Us:

Carepod is a premium humidifier brand operating in the US, Canada, and Australia. We’re growing fast and building a data-driven culture where insights actually shape decisions.

We’re looking for a Data Analyst who thinks like a business partner, not just a report builder.


What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain dashboards & projection tools such as sales, marketing, inventory, etc.
  • Analyze ecommerce & marketing data (Shopify, ads, reviews)
  • Identify trends in conversion, retention, and customer behavior
  • Support leadership with clear insights and recommendations
  • Answer real business questions, fast


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years experience as a Data Analyst
  • Strong SQL + Excel / Google Sheets
  • Experience with dashboards & KPIs
  • Exeprience with AI Automations such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, n8n, Make, Airtable, etc.
  • Ecommerce or DTC experience preferred
  • Comfortable communicating insights in English
  • Bonus: Python, BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI)


Why Carepod

  • Direct exposure to leadership
  • Real impact on decisions
  • International business experience
  • Fully remote, long-term opportunity


What We Offer:

 • Fully remote work environment

 • Competitive salary

 • Flexible PTO policy

 • Opportunity to grow with a scaling e-commerce brand

 • A supportive, collaborative, and agile team culture


⸻


To Apply:

  • Send your resume and a short note about why you’re a great fit

title: Supervisor de Inventário | DF
description:
Somos gente que cuida de gente. Cada um com características, histórias e qualidades únicas, mas todos unidos pelo mesmo propósito: viver plenamente. Temos orgulho da nossa história, por isso fazemos o nosso melhor hoje, sem deixar de olhar para o amanhã.


Se você preza pela valorização humana, integridade, foco no cliente, superação de resultados, sustentabilidade, inovação em soluções em tudo o que faz, vem fazer parte do nosso time de gigantes.


Como é o ambiente de trabalho?


Oferecemos um ambiente em que todos são protagonistas e agentes de transformação. Temos um excelente clima organizacional com pessoas engajadas em entregar os melhores resultados, assim como grandes oportunidades de crescimento para você.


Vem conferir!


Responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar equipes e procedimentos operacionais;
  • Zelar pelos equipamentos da companhia;
  • Realizar e acompanhar inventários de estoque de produtos em lojas e centros de distribuição;
  • Realizar inventário de materiais e ativos de TI.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior Cursando ou Completo na área Logística, Administrativa ou áreas afins;
  • Vivência básica na área de gestão;
  • Flexibilidade de horário;
  • Conhecimento em Prevenção de Perdas e/ou processos de Inventário;
  • Conhecimento no Pacote Office (Excel, Word e Access).

title: Engenheiro de Dados Senior
description:
Na Jaya Tech , acreditamos na Engenharia de Software Consciente , uma abordagem inovadora, e por isso oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho inspirador, focado em promover o autoconhecimento, tomar decisões embasadas em dados, cultivar relacionamentos saudáveis e entender o impacto do nosso trabalho. Aqui, você encontrará oportunidades para crescimento profissional e pessoal, contribuindo para projetos que têm um impacto significativo na indústria e na sociedade.


Sobre o Projeto

Você fará parte de um time em uma empresa inovadora, especializada em desenvolver soluções com Inteligencia Artificial (B2C) contribuindo para a transformação digital desse setor.


Atuação 100% remota | Forma de contratação: Contractor | Reuneração: Dólar | Full-time | Range: 5.2K a 6.2K


Requisitos Necessários


O que estamos procurando:


Ao avaliar candidatos para todos os cargos, buscamos pessoas com forte senso de propriedade, excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração, e dedicação à melhoria contínua.


● Experiência em engenharia de dados

● Domínio de Python e DBT Cloud, incluindo macros, testes, exposures e documentação para ETL/ELT

● Experiência com event streams e stream processing

● Experiência com controle de versão e CI/CD usando GitLab

● Experiência com orquestração de jobs (Airflow, DBT Jobs, Dagster)

● Familiaridade com Snowflake (clustering, otimização de queries, gestão de custos)

● Familiaridade com boas práticas de modelagem de dados (Kimball, Star, Snowflake) e sua aplicação em data warehouses

● Conforto com a linha de comando Unix/Linux



Experiências que vão nos impressionar muito:


● Familiaridade com eCommerce e os desafios de dados anônimos de clientes e suas interações

● Familiaridade com seguros de P&C (Property & Casualty)

● Formação em áreas como: Ciência, Tecnologia, Engenharia e Matemática

title: Thumbnail Designer (Art Director)  - Crypto Media
description:
We are the world’s No.1 LIVE Crypto Streaming Channel, covering Bitcoin, breaking news, altcoins, market moves, and the biggest names in the industry — every single day. From two enthusiasts streaming from a coffee shop to one of the fastest-growing crypto media networks, we now run a consortium of top YouTube channels for live news, trading, investing, web3, and gaming, partnering with the biggest brands and advertisers in the space. Born from a career at CNBC and the world’s first televised daily crypto news show, Crypto Banter was created to break free from corporate media and lead the Media 2.0 movement for tech, finance, and crypto .Today, with 80+ team members and over 10M monthly views, we’re hungrier than ever to build the most profitable and engaged community in the world. We’re a team of enthusiasts, misfits, and entrepreneurs who work harder than anyone in the industry — driven by passion, obsession, and the pursuit of the impossible. If that sounds like you, join us!


Role Overview

Crypto Banter creates multiple design assets on a daily basis for our content platforms. These design thumbnails encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching, interesting manner and act as a marketing asset for each show. We are looking for an art director with crypto knowledge that can assist the design team in conceptualizing and executing these designs and thumbnails on a daily basis. This role requires experience and knowledge of crypto to understand stories or news events and translate that understanding into punchy, eye-catching and impactful thumbnails to be used and packaged with the content that is distributed.


What you’ll do

  • Lead and Scale the Creative Squad: Direct a high-performance design team of three, managing the end-to-end execution of daily visual assets while collaborating with the Lead Art Director to maintain \"Brilliance or Nothing\" standards.
  • Conceptualise Viral Storytelling: Translate complex crypto news, market shifts, and \"breaking\" narratives into punchy, high-CTR YouTube thumbnails that encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching and urgent manner possible.
  • Rapid News Translation & Relay: Spearhead daily morning briefing calls to digest the latest market moves and breaking stories, immediately distilling these insights into actionable creative briefs for the design team.
  • Optimise for Performance & CTR: Apply a deep understanding of YouTube’s backend mechanics and audience psychology to create assets that win the \"click\" by a mile, ensuring all packaging is impactful and market-relevant.
  • Operationalise Design Workflows: Build and maintain a seamless, efficient design process that can withstand the intense time constraints of a live streaming environment, ensuring every show asset is ready for the \"Stream Team\" before go-live.
  • Cross-Functional Creative Direction: Provide expert art direction and execution for diverse auxiliary projects across the media network, ensuring a consistent and \"elite\" visual identity across all platforms.



Your skills and experience

  • Visual Storytelling and Execution: Proven ability to turn complex crypto narratives and \"breaking\" market news into high-impact YouTube thumbnails that are simple, urgent, and designed to win the click.
  • Crypto Fluency and Market Literacy: A deep-rooted \"fellow degen\" mentality with a daily obsession for watching the charts, following altcoins, and tracking the world’s biggest market moves.
  • Creative Leadership and Briefing: Experienced in leading and managing international design teams, with the ability to relay complex daily stories into clear, actionable creative briefs for rapid execution.
  • YouTube Psychology and Backend Mastery: A strong understanding of YouTube mechanics, specifically focusing on click-through rates (CTR) and audience retention strategies used by top-tier crypto and finance channels.
  • High-Velocity Performance: Exceptional ability to work under intense pressure and tight time constraints, delivering production-ready assets for live shows on a daily basis.
  • Strategic Communication and Copywriting: Sharp copywriting skills used to craft titles and visual hooks that capture attention while maintaining transparency and brand integrity

title: Senior Front-End Software Engineer (React.js / React Native / TypeScript)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Front-End Software Engineer with 5+ years of professional front-end development experience using React.js, React Native, and TypeScript for our U.K. / U.S. client. You will design, build, and maintain high‑impact user interfaces — from customer dashboards and data visualizations to our React Native mobile app.

Our client is a nature data and intelligence company on a mission to drive large-scale nature recovery. They combine data, science, and technology to help enterprises value and restore nature, creating measurable environmental and economic impact.


Responsibilities

  • Own front-end delivery for key product surfaces across web and mobile taking features from technical feasibility through technical design, implementation, release, and iteration
  • Build and evolve UI foundations including component patterns, design-system primitives, reusable layouts, and interaction standards that keep UX consistent as the product scales
  • Translate product and design intent into clear, intuitive user flows sweating the details on information hierarchy, micro-interactions, accessibility, and polish
  • Ship performant, data-heavy interfaces in Next.js / React.js, with strong attention to perceived performance (e.g., loading states, empty states, progressive disclosure, and responsiveness)
  • Contribute meaningfully to the React Native app, delivering cross-platform UI and shared patterns where it makes sense, while handling platform-specific edge cases when needed
  • Use automated testing to ensure the UI quality, stability, and performance
  • Partner tightly with Product, Design, and Tech Lead to scope work into thin, shippable increments, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and keep delivery moving without sacrificing quality


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of professional experience building production, front-end applications with React.js and TypeScript
  • Experience building and supporting cross-platform, React Native features in a production application
  • Strong eye for UI and UX quality, paying close attention to interaction behavior, information hierarchy, accessibility, and polish
  • Proven experience implementing and operating within a component library / design system (e.g., tokens, reusable components, consistency, and documentation) in close collaboration with Design
  • Strong fundamentals in state management, responsive design, and performance optimization including perceived performance (e.g., loading states, skeletons, optimistic UI, and smooth interactions)
  • Comfortable taking ambiguous product requirements and turning them into clear UI flows, iterating quickly with stakeholders, and owning outcomes
  • Shareable portfolio or examples of UI work (e.g. links, screenshots) as well as the ability to explain what you personally owned and enhanced
  • Proactive mindset and the ability to self-manage in a distributed environment
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment


Desired Experience

  • Experience with mobile release workflows (App Store / Play Store), build tooling, and troubleshooting React Native native-module / platform-specific issues
  • Experience with data visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js, Recharts) and/or map-based UI (e.g., Mapbox)


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Data Analyst | Ecommerce (Full-time Remote, BR)
description:
About Us:

Carepod is a premium humidifier brand operating in the US, Canada, and Australia. We’re growing fast and building a data-driven culture where insights actually shape decisions.

We’re looking for a Data Analyst who thinks like a business partner, not just a report builder.


What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain dashboards & projection tools such as sales, marketing, inventory, etc.
  • Analyze ecommerce & marketing data (Shopify, ads, reviews)
  • Identify trends in conversion, retention, and customer behavior
  • Support leadership with clear insights and recommendations
  • Answer real business questions, fast


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years experience as a Data Analyst
  • Strong SQL + Excel / Google Sheets
  • Experience with dashboards & KPIs
  • Exeprience with AI Automations such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, n8n, Make, Airtable, etc.
  • Ecommerce or DTC experience preferred
  • Comfortable communicating insights in English
  • Bonus: Python, BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI)


Why Carepod

  • Direct exposure to leadership
  • Real impact on decisions
  • International business experience
  • Fully remote, long-term opportunity


What We Offer:

 • Fully remote work environment

 • Competitive salary

 • Flexible PTO policy

 • Opportunity to grow with a scaling e-commerce brand

 • A supportive, collaborative, and agile team culture

title: Supervisor de Inventário | DF
description:
Somos gente que cuida de gente. Cada um com características, histórias e qualidades únicas, mas todos unidos pelo mesmo propósito: viver plenamente. Temos orgulho da nossa história, por isso fazemos o nosso melhor hoje, sem deixar de olhar para o amanhã.


Se você preza pela valorização humana, integridade, foco no cliente, superação de resultados, sustentabilidade, inovação em soluções em tudo o que faz, vem fazer parte do nosso time de gigantes.


Como é o ambiente de trabalho?


Oferecemos um ambiente em que todos são protagonistas e agentes de transformação. Temos um excelente clima organizacional com pessoas engajadas em entregar os melhores resultados, assim como grandes oportunidades de crescimento para você.


Vem conferir!


Responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar equipes e procedimentos operacionais;
  • Zelar pelos equipamentos da companhia;
  • Realizar e acompanhar inventários de estoque de produtos em lojas e centros de distribuição;
  • Realizar inventário de materiais e ativos de TI.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior Cursando ou Completo na área Logística, Administrativa ou áreas afins;
  • Vivência básica na área de gestão;
  • Flexibilidade de horário;
  • Conhecimento em Prevenção de Perdas e/ou processos de Inventário;
  • Conhecimento no Pacote Office (Excel, Word e Access).

title: Engenheiro de Dados Senior
description:
Na Jaya Tech , acreditamos na Engenharia de Software Consciente , uma abordagem inovadora, e por isso oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho inspirador, focado em promover o autoconhecimento, tomar decisões embasadas em dados, cultivar relacionamentos saudáveis e entender o impacto do nosso trabalho. Aqui, você encontrará oportunidades para crescimento profissional e pessoal, contribuindo para projetos que têm um impacto significativo na indústria e na sociedade.


Sobre o Projeto

Você fará parte de um time em uma empresa inovadora, especializada em desenvolver soluções com Inteligencia Artificial (B2C) contribuindo para a transformação digital desse setor.


Atuação 100% remota | Forma de contratação: Contractor | Reuneração: Dólar | Full-time | Range: 5.2K a 6.2K


Requisitos Necessários


O que estamos procurando:


Ao avaliar candidatos para todos os cargos, buscamos pessoas com forte senso de propriedade, excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração, e dedicação à melhoria contínua.


● Experiência em engenharia de dados

● Domínio de Python e DBT Cloud, incluindo macros, testes, exposures e documentação para ETL/ELT

● Experiência com event streams e stream processing

● Experiência com controle de versão e CI/CD usando GitLab

● Experiência com orquestração de jobs (Airflow, DBT Jobs, Dagster)

● Familiaridade com Snowflake (clustering, otimização de queries, gestão de custos)

● Familiaridade com boas práticas de modelagem de dados (Kimball, Star, Snowflake) e sua aplicação em data warehouses

● Conforto com a linha de comando Unix/Linux



Experiências que vão nos impressionar muito:


● Familiaridade com eCommerce e os desafios de dados anônimos de clientes e suas interações

● Familiaridade com seguros de P&C (Property & Casualty)

● Formação em áreas como: Ciência, Tecnologia, Engenharia e Matemática

title: Thumbnail Designer (Art Director)  - Crypto Media
description:
We are the world’s No.1 LIVE Crypto Streaming Channel, covering Bitcoin, breaking news, altcoins, market moves, and the biggest names in the industry — every single day. From two enthusiasts streaming from a coffee shop to one of the fastest-growing crypto media networks, we now run a consortium of top YouTube channels for live news, trading, investing, web3, and gaming, partnering with the biggest brands and advertisers in the space. Born from a career at CNBC and the world’s first televised daily crypto news show, Crypto Banter was created to break free from corporate media and lead the Media 2.0 movement for tech, finance, and crypto .Today, with 80+ team members and over 10M monthly views, we’re hungrier than ever to build the most profitable and engaged community in the world. We’re a team of enthusiasts, misfits, and entrepreneurs who work harder than anyone in the industry — driven by passion, obsession, and the pursuit of the impossible. If that sounds like you, join us!


Role Overview

Crypto Banter creates multiple design assets on a daily basis for our content platforms. These design thumbnails encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching, interesting manner and act as a marketing asset for each show. We are looking for an art director with crypto knowledge that can assist the design team in conceptualizing and executing these designs and thumbnails on a daily basis. This role requires experience and knowledge of crypto to understand stories or news events and translate that understanding into punchy, eye-catching and impactful thumbnails to be used and packaged with the content that is distributed.


What you’ll do

  • Lead and Scale the Creative Squad: Direct a high-performance design team of three, managing the end-to-end execution of daily visual assets while collaborating with the Lead Art Director to maintain \"Brilliance or Nothing\" standards.
  • Conceptualise Viral Storytelling: Translate complex crypto news, market shifts, and \"breaking\" narratives into punchy, high-CTR YouTube thumbnails that encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching and urgent manner possible.
  • Rapid News Translation & Relay: Spearhead daily morning briefing calls to digest the latest market moves and breaking stories, immediately distilling these insights into actionable creative briefs for the design team.
  • Optimise for Performance & CTR: Apply a deep understanding of YouTube’s backend mechanics and audience psychology to create assets that win the \"click\" by a mile, ensuring all packaging is impactful and market-relevant.
  • Operationalise Design Workflows: Build and maintain a seamless, efficient design process that can withstand the intense time constraints of a live streaming environment, ensuring every show asset is ready for the \"Stream Team\" before go-live.
  • Cross-Functional Creative Direction: Provide expert art direction and execution for diverse auxiliary projects across the media network, ensuring a consistent and \"elite\" visual identity across all platforms.



Your skills and experience

  • Visual Storytelling and Execution: Proven ability to turn complex crypto narratives and \"breaking\" market news into high-impact YouTube thumbnails that are simple, urgent, and designed to win the click.
  • Crypto Fluency and Market Literacy: A deep-rooted \"fellow degen\" mentality with a daily obsession for watching the charts, following altcoins, and tracking the world’s biggest market moves.
  • Creative Leadership and Briefing: Experienced in leading and managing international design teams, with the ability to relay complex daily stories into clear, actionable creative briefs for rapid execution.
  • YouTube Psychology and Backend Mastery: A strong understanding of YouTube mechanics, specifically focusing on click-through rates (CTR) and audience retention strategies used by top-tier crypto and finance channels.
  • High-Velocity Performance: Exceptional ability to work under intense pressure and tight time constraints, delivering production-ready assets for live shows on a daily basis.
  • Strategic Communication and Copywriting: Sharp copywriting skills used to craft titles and visual hooks that capture attention while maintaining transparency and brand integrity

From two enthusiasts streaming from a coffee shop to one of the fastest-growing crypto media networks, we now run a consortium of top YouTube channels for live news, trading, investing, web3, and gaming, partnering with the biggest brands and advertisers in the space. Born from a career at CNBC and the world’s first televised daily crypto news show, Crypto Banter was created to break free from corporate media and lead the Media 2.0 movement for tech, finance, and crypto .Today, with 80+ team members and over 10M monthly views, we’re hungrier than ever to build the most profitable and engaged community in the world. We’re a team of enthusiasts, misfits, and entrepreneurs who work harder than anyone in the industry — driven by passion, obsession, and the pursuit of the impossible. If that sounds like you, join us!


Role Overview

Crypto Banter creates multiple design assets on a daily basis for our content platforms. These design thumbnails encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching, interesting manner and act as a marketing asset for each show. We are looking for an art director with crypto knowledge that can assist the design team in conceptualizing and executing these designs and thumbnails on a daily basis. This role requires experience and knowledge of crypto to understand stories or news events and translate that understanding into punchy, eye-catching and impactful thumbnails to be used and packaged with the content that is distributed.


What you’ll do

  • Lead and Scale the Creative Squad: Direct a high-performance design team of three, managing the end-to-end execution of daily visual assets while collaborating with the Lead Art Director to maintain \"Brilliance or Nothing\" standards.
  • Conceptualise Viral Storytelling: Translate complex crypto news, market shifts, and \"breaking\" narratives into punchy, high-CTR YouTube thumbnails that encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching and urgent manner possible.
  • Rapid News Translation & Relay: Spearhead daily morning briefing calls to digest the latest market moves and breaking stories, immediately distilling these insights into actionable creative briefs for the design team.
  • Optimise for Performance & CTR: Apply a deep understanding of YouTube’s backend mechanics and audience psychology to create assets that win the \"click\" by a mile, ensuring all packaging is impactful and market-relevant.
  • Operationalise Design Workflows: Build and maintain a seamless, efficient design process that can withstand the intense time constraints of a live streaming environment, ensuring every show asset is ready for the \"Stream Team\" before go-live.
  • Cross-Functional Creative Direction: Provide expert art direction and execution for diverse auxiliary projects across the media network, ensuring a consistent and \"elite\" visual identity across all platforms.



Your skills and experience

  • Visual Storytelling and Execution: Proven ability to turn complex crypto narratives and \"breaking\" market news into high-impact YouTube thumbnails that are simple, urgent, and designed to win the click.
  • Crypto Fluency and Market Literacy: A deep-rooted \"fellow degen\" mentality with a daily obsession for watching the charts, following altcoins, and tracking the world’s biggest market moves.
  • Creative Leadership and Briefing: Experienced in leading and managing international design teams, with the ability to relay complex daily stories into clear, actionable creative briefs for rapid execution.
  • YouTube Psychology and Backend Mastery: A strong understanding of YouTube mechanics, specifically focusing on click-through rates (CTR) and audience retention strategies used by top-tier crypto and finance channels.
  • High-Velocity Performance: Exceptional ability to work under intense pressure and tight time constraints, delivering production-ready assets for live shows on a daily basis.
  • Strategic Communication and Copywriting: Sharp copywriting skills used to craft titles and visual hooks that capture attention while maintaining transparency and brand integrity

title: Senior Front-End Software Engineer (React.js / React Native / TypeScript)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Front-End Software Engineer with 5+ years of professional front-end development experience using React.js, React Native, and TypeScript for our U.K. / U.S. client. You will design, build, and maintain high‑impact user interfaces — from customer dashboards and data visualizations to our React Native mobile app.

Our client is a nature data and intelligence company on a mission to drive large-scale nature recovery. They combine data, science, and technology to help enterprises value and restore nature, creating measurable environmental and economic impact.


Responsibilities

  • Own front-end delivery for key product surfaces across web and mobile taking features from technical feasibility through technical design, implementation, release, and iteration
  • Build and evolve UI foundations including component patterns, design-system primitives, reusable layouts, and interaction standards that keep UX consistent as the product scales
  • Translate product and design intent into clear, intuitive user flows sweating the details on information hierarchy, micro-interactions, accessibility, and polish
  • Ship performant, data-heavy interfaces in Next.js / React.js, with strong attention to perceived performance (e.g., loading states, empty states, progressive disclosure, and responsiveness)
  • Contribute meaningfully to the React Native app, delivering cross-platform UI and shared patterns where it makes sense, while handling platform-specific edge cases when needed
  • Use automated testing to ensure the UI quality, stability, and performance
  • Partner tightly with Product, Design, and Tech Lead to scope work into thin, shippable increments, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and keep delivery moving without sacrificing quality


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of professional experience building production, front-end applications with React.js and TypeScript
  • Experience building and supporting cross-platform, React Native features in a production application
  • Strong eye for UI and UX quality, paying close attention to interaction behavior, information hierarchy, accessibility, and polish
  • Proven experience implementing and operating within a component library / design system (e.g., tokens, reusable components, consistency, and documentation) in close collaboration with Design
  • Strong fundamentals in state management, responsive design, and performance optimization including perceived performance (e.g., loading states, skeletons, optimistic UI, and smooth interactions)
  • Comfortable taking ambiguous product requirements and turning them into clear UI flows, iterating quickly with stakeholders, and owning outcomes
  • Shareable portfolio or examples of UI work (e.g. links, screenshots) as well as the ability to explain what you personally owned and enhanced
  • Proactive mindset and the ability to self-manage in a distributed environment
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment


Desired Experience

  • Experience with mobile release workflows (App Store / Play Store), build tooling, and troubleshooting React Native native-module / platform-specific issues
  • Experience with data visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js, Recharts) and/or map-based UI (e.g., Mapbox)


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Engenheiro de Dados Senior
description:
Na Jaya Tech , acreditamos na Engenharia de Software Consciente , uma abordagem inovadora, e por isso oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho inspirador, focado em promover o autoconhecimento, tomar decisões embasadas em dados, cultivar relacionamentos saudáveis e entender o impacto do nosso trabalho. Aqui, você encontrará oportunidades para crescimento profissional e pessoal, contribuindo para projetos que têm um impacto significativo na indústria e na sociedade.


Sobre o Projeto

Você fará parte de um time em uma empresa inovadora, especializada em desenvolver soluções com Inteligencia Artificial (B2C) contribuindo para a transformação digital desse setor.


Atuação 100% remota | Forma de contratação: Contractor | Reuneração: Dólar | Full-time | Range: 5.2K a 6.2K


Requisitos Necessários


O que estamos procurando:


Ao avaliar candidatos para todos os cargos, buscamos pessoas com forte senso de propriedade, excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração, e dedicação à melhoria contínua.


● Experiência em engenharia de dados

● Domínio de Python e DBT Cloud, incluindo macros, testes, exposures e documentação para ETL/ELT

● Experiência com event streams e stream processing

● Experiência com controle de versão e CI/CD usando GitLab

● Experiência com orquestração de jobs (Airflow, DBT Jobs, Dagster)

● Familiaridade com Snowflake (clustering, otimização de queries, gestão de custos)

● Familiaridade com boas práticas de modelagem de dados (Kimball, Star, Snowflake) e sua aplicação em data warehouses

● Conforto com a linha de comando Unix/Linux



Experiências que vão nos impressionar muito:


● Familiaridade com eCommerce e os desafios de dados anônimos de clientes e suas interações

● Familiaridade com seguros de P&C (Property & Casualty)

● Formação em áreas como: Ciência, Tecnologia, Engenharia e Matemática

title: Thumbnail Designer (Art Director)  - Crypto Media
description:
We are the world’s No.1 LIVE Crypto Streaming Channel, covering Bitcoin, breaking news, altcoins, market moves, and the biggest names in the industry — every single day. From two enthusiasts streaming from a coffee shop to one of the fastest-growing crypto media networks, we now run a consortium of top YouTube channels for live news, trading, investing, web3, and gaming, partnering with the biggest brands and advertisers in the space. Born from a career at CNBC and the world’s first televised daily crypto news show, Crypto Banter was created to break free from corporate media and lead the Media 2.0 movement for tech, finance, and crypto .Today, with 80+ team members and over 10M monthly views, we’re hungrier than ever to build the most profitable and engaged community in the world. We’re a team of enthusiasts, misfits, and entrepreneurs who work harder than anyone in the industry — driven by passion, obsession, and the pursuit of the impossible. If that sounds like you, join us!


Role Overview

Crypto Banter creates multiple design assets on a daily basis for our content platforms. These design thumbnails encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching, interesting manner and act as a marketing asset for each show. We are looking for an art director with crypto knowledge that can assist the design team in conceptualizing and executing these designs and thumbnails on a daily basis. This role requires experience and knowledge of crypto to understand stories or news events and translate that understanding into punchy, eye-catching and impactful thumbnails to be used and packaged with the content that is distributed.


What you’ll do

  • Lead and Scale the Creative Squad: Direct a high-performance design team of three, managing the end-to-end execution of daily visual assets while collaborating with the Lead Art Director to maintain \"Brilliance or Nothing\" standards.
  • Conceptualise Viral Storytelling: Translate complex crypto news, market shifts, and \"breaking\" narratives into punchy, high-CTR YouTube thumbnails that encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching and urgent manner possible.
  • Rapid News Translation & Relay: Spearhead daily morning briefing calls to digest the latest market moves and breaking stories, immediately distilling these insights into actionable creative briefs for the design team.
  • Optimise for Performance & CTR: Apply a deep understanding of YouTube’s backend mechanics and audience psychology to create assets that win the \"click\" by a mile, ensuring all packaging is impactful and market-relevant.
  • Operationalise Design Workflows: Build and maintain a seamless, efficient design process that can withstand the intense time constraints of a live streaming environment, ensuring every show asset is ready for the \"Stream Team\" before go-live.
  • Cross-Functional Creative Direction: Provide expert art direction and execution for diverse auxiliary projects across the media network, ensuring a consistent and \"elite\" visual identity across all platforms.



Your skills and experience

  • Visual Storytelling and Execution: Proven ability to turn complex crypto narratives and \"breaking\" market news into high-impact YouTube thumbnails that are simple, urgent, and designed to win the click.
  • Crypto Fluency and Market Literacy: A deep-rooted \"fellow degen\" mentality with a daily obsession for watching the charts, following altcoins, and tracking the world’s biggest market moves.
  • Creative Leadership and Briefing: Experienced in leading and managing international design teams, with the ability to relay complex daily stories into clear, actionable creative briefs for rapid execution.
  • YouTube Psychology and Backend Mastery: A strong understanding of YouTube mechanics, specifically focusing on click-through rates (CTR) and audience retention strategies used by top-tier crypto and finance channels.
  • High-Velocity Performance: Exceptional ability to work under intense pressure and tight time constraints, delivering production-ready assets for live shows on a daily basis.
  • Strategic Communication and Copywriting: Sharp copywriting skills used to craft titles and visual hooks that capture attention while maintaining transparency and brand integrity
